title: Lilac Gold Double Wall Plastic Tumbler with Straw, 24oz
descriptionText:
This Lilac Gold Double Wall Plastic Tumbler comes with a cup, lid and straw, making it perfect for all occasions. The round shape and textured style of this tumbler make it a stylish addition to any collection. It has a 24 oz capacity and is dishwasher safe, but please note that it is top rack only. 

This tumbler is made of plastic and has a solid pattern with pink/gold color accents. It is studded with pink studs, giving it a fun and trendy touch. This tumbler is perfect for teens, adults, and kids and is ideal for enjoying cold drinks and water. It is a Mainstays character family product and has no California Prop 65 Warning.
